stories.title: BrainChip adds SPI-connected on-device learning to existing microcontroller designs
stories.summary:
BrainChip announced the AKD1500 SPI on October 26, a neuromorphic coprocessor designed to add local AI to microcontroller-based devices through their existing SPI interface.[6] The host microcontroller retains device control while passing sensor data to the coprocessor, which runs the neural network and returns a result such as a recognized word or detected fault.[6] BrainChip says the chip supports on-device learning and multiple AI tasks, and is available through its shop, DigiKey or direct sales.[6] The announcement includes partner comments about embedded evaluation and EEG glasses, but supplies no independent power benchmark, clinical validation or evidence of a large healthcare deployment.[6] For hardware integrators, the useful test is whether a sensor-classification or voice-trigger workload can meet its accuracy, power and latency budget without replacing the existing controller.

Sources:
[6] https://design-reuse.com/news/202531328-brainchip-unveils-akd1500-spi-chip-bringing-neuromorphic-ai-to-everyday-edge-devices

stories.title: Cognizant and EBRD agree five-year AI-enabled managed-services framework
stories.summary:
Cognizant announced on October 26 that the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development selected it for a five-year technology-services framework supporting the banks Tech Blueprint transformation programme.[1] The engagement combines outcome-led managed services with fixed-capacity services across workplace management, infrastructure, data, security, software engineering, automation and AI.[1] Cognizant plans to apply Neuro IT Operations, Flowsource and WorkNEXT to operational visibility, software development and AI-assisted workplace support; these are planned delivery capabilities, not demonstrated customer results.[1] EBRD technology leaders quoted in the announcement confirm the relationship and its managed-services focus, distinguishing the engagement from simple platform resale.[1] The release discloses no contract value, unit prices or measured savings.[1] For an agency, the relevant model is to separate a defined delivery-capacity retainer from outcome-linked operational work, with acceptance criteria and human escalation agreed before deployment.

Sources:
[1] https://news.cognizant.com/2026-10-26-Cognizant-and-EBRD-Partner-to-Accelerate-Digital-Transformation-Through-AI-Led,-Outcome-Driven-Services
